title: Alibaba.com-Category Manager-Sunnyvale
description:
Role Overview:
As a Category Manager, you will be the "CEO" of your assigned business categories. You are responsible for the end-to-end growth, strategic direction, and P&L performance of specific vertical markets (e.g., MRO, Construction, or F&B Supplies). You will bridge the gap between global supply capabilities and North American buyer demands, driving selection expansion, pricing strategy, and buyer engagement.

Core Responsibilities:
● Strategic Category Planning: Develop and execute a 12-24 month roadmap for the category. Identify market trends, white-space opportunities, and competitive threats within the B2B landscape.
● Selection & Supply Management: Identify, onboard, and manage high-quality manufacturers and wholesalers. Ensure the selection meets the rigorous standards of professional buyers (e.g., certifications, bulk availability, customization capabilities).
● P&L & Performance Ownership: Own key business metrics including GMV (Gross Merchandise Volume), Take Rate, Selection Depth, and Active Seller/Buyer growth.
● Buyer Persona Insights: Work closely with Marketing to define buyer cohorts (e.g., General Contractors, Restaurant Owners, Facility Managers). Tailor the category experience to solve their specific procurement pain points.
● Product & Catalog Optimization: Partner with Product teams to improve the "Search-to-Inquiry" or "Search-to-Purchase" flow. Ensure technical specifications, bulk pricing tiers, and shipping attributes are structured for a seamless B2B buying experience.
● Promotional Strategy: Design and lead category-specific events, trade shows (digital/physical), and seasonal campaigns to drive buyer retention and reactivate dormant accounts.

The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between $126,000/year and $207600/year. However, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

If hired, employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

Required Qualifications:
● Experience: 5+ years of experience in Category Management, Strategic Sourcing, or Merchandising. Experience in a B2B E-commerce marketplace is highly preferred.
● Industry Expertise: Deep knowledge of at least one of the following sectors: Industrial Machinery, Building Materials, Commercial Kitchen Equipment, or Packaging Supplies.
● Analytical Rigor: Proficiency in SQL and Excel. Ability to pivot between high-level strategy and granular data analysis (e.g., cohort retention, SKU-level elasticity).
● Communication: Exceptional negotiation skills and the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders (Product, Tech, Sales, and Legal).
● Education: Bachelor’s degree required; MBA from a top-tier university is a strong plus.
● AI tools user and AI skills owner.

title: Alibaba.com-Partner Marketing Expert-Sunnyvale
description:
This strategic role is dedicated to spearheading global brand construction and driving business growth through a partner-led marketing framework. As a Partner Marketing Expert, you will be responsible for ideating, curating, and delivering high-impact, buzz-worthy joint marketing initiatives and co-branded experiential programs. By strategically leveraging the reach and influence of marketing partners, you will amplify Alibaba.com’s ecosystem—including our cutting-edge AI solutions and buyer success stories—positioning them at the forefront of the global market through shared audiences and collaborative storytelling.

Key Responsibilities:
Strategic Partnership Development: Build and evolve marketing partnerships from high-level strategy through to meticulous execution. This includes experiential strategy, marketing rights negotiation, and the development of new partnership programs from the ground up.
AI Solution Branding & Growth: Specifically drive the brand positioning and market adoption of Alibaba.com’s AI solutions within the global retail and e-commerce sectors, leveraging technology to create competitive advantages.
End-to-End Program Management: Oversee the entire lifecycle of marketing activations, including vendor identification, contract negotiation, creative production, on-site management, and post-event ROI analysis.
Stakeholder Orchestration: Act as a central hub between multiple internal stakeholders (Brand Marketing, Sales, Content, PR, Legal, Finance, and Procurement) and external agencies to ensure a unified and integrated approach.

Academic Background: Bachelor’s degree or higher in Marketing, Business, or a related field.
Professional Standing: Minimum 5-8 years of experience in business development, strategic partnerships, or integrated marketing.
Industry Expertise: Proven track record in the E-commerce, Retail, or AI/Tech sectors. Experience working within the B2B space or with Small Business Owners is highly preferred.
Power Network: Must possess a deep and active network of connections within the global retail and AI ecosystems, with the proven ability to leverage these relationships to build lasting, high-value partnerships.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
Growth Mindset: Strong experience in business-driven growth and operations, with the ability to turn brand activations into measurable business results.
Strategic & Creative Thinking: Ability to research and recommend innovative solutions, finding creative ways to activate current partnerships and KOLs in the ever-evolving AI and digital landscape.
Exceptional Communication: Extremely proficient in both written and verbal communication; comfortable with public speaking and delivering high-stakes presentations to executive leadership.
Executive Presence: Customer service-oriented demeanor with the ability to influence and lead cross-functional teams and external partners.
Operational Excellence: Outstanding organizational skills, capable of meeting tight deadlines while balancing multiple high-priority projects with consistent attention to detail.
Tech Savviness: Proficient in Microsoft Office suite and CRM software; a natural curiosity for AI tools and their application in business.
Resilience & Agility: Comfort in ambiguity—you are a resourceful problem-solver who can navigate complex environments and seek out new information independently.
Flexibility: Ability to work flexible hours and travel globally as required to manage international programs.

title: Alibaba Holding-Director, Federal Government Affairs-Washington D.C
description:
The Director, Federal Government Affairs for the U.S. will report to the Head of Government Relations for North America. This role will manage proactive engagement with and monitoring of relevant government officials and actions related to Alibaba and its ecosystem at the Federal level, particularly with respect to Agencies. S/He will strategically manage Alibaba’s legislative and regulatory advocacy initiatives related to ecommerce, digital services, product safety, intellectual property, technology development and deployment, consumer protection, logistics, customs, export controls, tax, and competition issues. The Director, Federal Government Relations will be charged with understanding and working effectively within the political dynamics presented by advocating for a global business headquartered in China. This role will also include day-to-day engagement with external resources, such as consultancies and trade associations, as well as any relevant third-party relationships. It is important that s/he be able to anticipate risks and opportunities, advise on engagement strategies and advocate on behalf of Alibaba.

In addition, the Director, Federal Government Affairs for the U.S. will:

• Work within the IGA team to develop and execute a government affairs program for Alibaba in the region which advances its business growth, legislative and regulatory goals, and political objectives.
• Develop and foster relationships with key officials, engage via industry and government forums and manage relevant consultants and trade associations.
• Establish solid working relationships with colleagues at headquarters and work closely with colleagues internationally to develop and implement industry and government outreach.
• Provide senior executives and colleagues with strategic advice and insightful perspectives concerning government actions and politics regarding the industry and Alibaba in particular.
• Coordinate across internal teams to ensure proper compliance with regulations and follow-through on government messaging.

The compensation package for this position is comprised of base salary ($188,400–$309,600), bonus, equity and/or cash incentive award, as well as health care and other group benefit plans.

The successful candidate will have at least 5 years of progressively more responsible professional experience. The preferred candidate will possess a background in government relations and Agency engagement, and will have spent some time working in both the public and private sector. S/He will have a successful track record managing high-level relationships and executing innovative government affairs initiatives to achieve corporate business objectives on both the regulatory and client development fronts. S/He will have significant relevant business and government stakeholder relationship experience. A clear reputation for ethical conduct is required.

Qualification considerations include:
• Strong cultural adaptability and keen learning capacity.
• Strong decision-making and strategic thinking skills; ability to quickly grasp, address, prioritize and anticipate emerging issues – as well as recommend positions on issues and suggest changes in strategies as relevant legislative and regulatory processes unfold, with an ability to navigate complex and competitive policy issues.
• Solid relationships and a thorough understanding of key legislative and regulatory processes, including an understanding of the role and capacity of third-party stakeholder entities such as trade associations and other related organizations, to advance the business interests of Alibaba Group.
• Strong executive presence with excellent oral and written communication skills to represent the company effectively before relevant stakeholders and audiences. Any Mandarin language proficiency or willingness to learn the languages would be an additional plus.
• A collaborative style with an ability to work cross-functionally with subject matter experts, senior leaders and key stakeholders; interactive with the courage and conviction to challenge and defend ideas and strategies; clear reputation for ethical conduct and unquestionable integrity.
• A track record of strong, demonstrated results in both political and corporate environments.
• Ability to evaluate competing interests of industry players and develop successful strategies to steer around obstacles and obtain desirable outcomes.
• Possess a keen attention to detail and accuracy in a fast-moving and challenging political and policy environment, with international dimension.
• Must demonstrate a sense of urgency with the ability to maintain a clear head in stressful situations.
• Ability to effectively manage multiple ongoing projects at once while appropriately allocating time and resources.
